entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the banks of the Zpana River in..."
entries.dialogueText: On the banks of the Zpana River in Bronaz stood Palas Verana.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Almost as opulent as my own palace,..."
entries.dialogueText: Almost as opulent as my own palace, it had once served as a summer residence for my ancestors, the Rubaz family.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Today it was the home of Russello "..."
entries.dialogueText: Today it was the home of Russello "Rusty" Montoro. The CEO of Rizian Royal Gold, and the wealthiest commoner in the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stepped out onto the deck of the..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped out onto the deck of the Rizania as the yacht approached the palace's private dock. Hugo and Elena were already there, gazing out at the grounds.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I can't believe what I'm seeing. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe what I'm seeing. Palas Verana without its water garden is no palace at all."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I think it's an improvement, mysel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's an improvement, myself. But what do you make of this, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked in the direction she was i..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked in the direction she was indicating. The water garden, once a tranquil oasis filled with blossoming flowers and gently burbling fountains, had been replaced with a gigantic gold-tiled swimming pool.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hideous. I hate new money.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hideous. I hate new money."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Seems practical. I never understoo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seems practical. I never understood the appeal of water gardens anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why don't we have one of these at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why don't we have one of these at Palas Rezna?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Because we have taste.""
entries.dialogueText: "Because we have taste."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""They're attractive, to be sure. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're attractive, to be sure. But at the height of summer, looking at fountains you can't swim in is just torturous."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'd be surprised if Mr. Montoro ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd be surprised if Mr. Montoro even used it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gold magnate's red hair was str..."
entries.dialogueText: The gold magnate's red hair was streaked with grey, but his eyes had a youthful mischief about them.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""On behalf of all of us at the este..."
entries.dialogueText: "On behalf of all of us at the esteemed Rizian Royal Gold corporation, I do hereby extend my cordial greetings to your royal delegation..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He trailed off with a grin."
entries.dialogueText: He trailed off with a grin.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Heck, I was never one for formalit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heck, I was never one for formalities. Welcome to my palace, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a pleasure, Rusty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a pleasure, Rusty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Mr. Montoro.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Montoro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You certainly have made it yours,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You certainly have made it yours, haven't you?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Oh, the pool? I can't stand swimmi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, the pool? I can't stand swimming myself. Get sunburned at the drop of a hat. The grandkids love it, though."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to Hugo and Elena."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to Hugo and Elena.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your Grace, Madam Treasurer. Haven..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Grace, Madam Treasurer. Haven't had a sit-down with you two since the last gentleman wore the crown."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You must mean my honorable brother..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must mean my honorable brother, His Majesty King Valero. May he rest in peace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle gritted his teeth."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle gritted his teeth.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Now, Hugo. Rusty paid his respects..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Hugo. Rusty paid his respects at the funeral like everyone else."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook Rusty's hand. He beckoned..."
entries.dialogueText: She shook Rusty's hand. He beckoned for us to sit as his valets brought over water and fresh fruit.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Rusty, please. Calling me 'Mr. Mon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rusty, please. Calling me 'Mr. Montoro' is like trying to put an elevator in an outhouse."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Now. As you know, Rizian Royal Gol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. As you know, Rizian Royal Gold boasts a long, proud history of cooperation with the Crown."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That deal was your father's idea,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That deal was your father's idea, Your Majesty. All I was asking for was fair compensation for what my company lost. As any CEO would."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""My point being. As a trusted busin..."
entries.dialogueText: "My point being. As a trusted business associate, there's something I need to bring to your attention."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Feast your eyes on this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Feast your eyes on this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up a piece of paper from..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up a piece of paper from the table next to him. It was a flyer with a few sentences written in both Rizian and Wehzek.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A Malenyevist. A dangerous figure.""
entries.dialogueText: "A Malenyevist. A dangerous figure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The first female Prime Minister of..."
entries.dialogueText: "The first female Prime Minister of Morella. A pioneer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's not a threat.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's not a threat."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""A pioneering pain in both of our b..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pioneering pain in both of our behinds."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Right, Your Majesty. Banning propa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right, Your Majesty. Banning propaganda in Rizia won't stop what's happening on her side of the border."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Woman's never picked up a chisel i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Woman's never picked up a chisel in her life, and she suddenly knows how to run the MITZ."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's right, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's right, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""She wouldn't be if she stuck to go..."
entries.dialogueText: "She wouldn't be if she stuck to governing Morella. You know, like she was elected to do."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Supervisors at my mines have gotte..."
entries.dialogueText: "Supervisors at my mines have gotten word that the workers are holding after-hours meetings. On the subject of 'unsafe conditions'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you tried, let's see, improvi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you tried, let's see, improving those conditions?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They should be grateful to be empl..."
entries.dialogueText: "They should be grateful to be employed at all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The first step to unionizing?""
entries.dialogueText: "The first step to unionizing?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Don't know if I'd go that far. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't know if I'd go that far. But the more employees put their heads together, the more dangerous their ideas get."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""They were before. Someone's been p..."
entries.dialogueText: "They were before. Someone's been putting ideas in their heads."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I mean, we would if they brought u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I mean, we would if they brought up the subject with us directly. But seems they'd rather conspire amongst themselves."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Have there been any accidents late..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have there been any accidents lately? Anything that might have triggered this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty snorted."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty snorted.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Accidents have been part of this j..."
entries.dialogueText: "Accidents have been part of this job since the dawn of time. Used to say you weren't a real miner until you were missing a finger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's barbaric.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's barbaric."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you need all ten of them f..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you need all ten of them for, anyway?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you ever even work in the mine..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you ever even work in the mines yourself, Rusty?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""As long as you've got enough to sw..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you've got enough to swing a pickaxe."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty slowly held up his left hand...."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty slowly held up his left hand. His little finger had been lopped off at the second joint.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's reality. Not all of us have..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's reality. Not all of us have estates to live off, you know."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Do you have a request of His Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have a request of His Majesty, Mr. Montoro? Or have you merely invited us here to complain?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Not complain. Warn.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not complain. Warn."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If I'm right, they're about to pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I'm right, they're about to propose a big new batch of workplace regulations. Not just for RRG, but for everyone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How much revenue would RRG stand t..."
entries.dialogueText: "How much revenue would RRG stand to lose?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We still have the Meftiem Internat..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have the Meftiem International Trade Zone, don't we? The rules wouldn't apply there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The company will rebound when we g..."
entries.dialogueText: "The company will rebound when we get Zille back."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hard to say. Implementing the regu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hard to say. Implementing the regulations themselves would cost a pretty penny."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And what do you think will happen..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what do you think will happen if we pass those costs on to our trading partners? They'll hit the road faster than my first ex-wife."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Well, that's the other thing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that's the other thing."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sure, RRG isn't a direct stakehold..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, RRG isn't a direct stakeholder in the Trade Zone. But we're involved enough to be highly worried about Alma Saltana."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We'll see about that, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll see about that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena raised her eyebrows."
entries.dialogueText: Elena raised her eyebrows.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We have been seeing more global co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have been seeing more global competition on the gold market, unfortunately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aren't most RRG miners labor hands..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't most RRG miners labor hands from foreign countries? Would the regulations even apply to them?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Morella doesn't have unilateral po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella doesn't have unilateral power over the International Trade Zone. Rizia, Lespia and Valgsland all have a say."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And guess which one of those Ms. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "And guess which one of those Ms. Saltana has been cozying up to on this subject?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If she and Hegel get their way, Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she and Hegel get their way, Rizia will either lose its mining rights or our boys will have to pray to Malenyev before going to work every morning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, Malenyev is a staunch at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, Malenyev is a staunch atheist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That still leaves us and Lespia.""
entries.dialogueText: "That still leaves us and Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She should have the right to deter..."
entries.dialogueText: "She should have the right to determine how gold is mined in her own country."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Gold Regs Hub

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""They most certainly would, now tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "They most certainly would, now that labor hands have the same protections as honest-to-goodness Rizians."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""25 years ago, that little nub of l..."
entries.dialogueText: "25 years ago, that little nub of land was home to some of the fattest gold veins my company's ever found. But Nur knows what shape it's in now."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's Chancellor Hegel's influence..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's Chancellor Hegel's influence that is concerning. Malenyevism has a way of spilling over borders."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It's hard to say if we can count o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's hard to say if we can count on Lespia's cooperation. Of course they abhor Valgsland, but we don't have the friendliest history with them either."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Another reason to keep his influen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Another reason to keep his influence far from our borders."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter what, our revenue from t..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what, our revenue from the region takes a hit."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And the CSP will claim another vic..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the CSP will claim another victory."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The political aspect isn't as conc..."
entries.dialogueText: "The political aspect isn't as concerning to me as the loss of access to our most important mines. We have to keep a close eye on this."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""She's started calling for regulati..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's started calling for regulation over there as well. Or worse, nationalization."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We'll have to keep a close eye on..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll have to keep a close eye on this."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Honestly, Your Majesty, I just abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, Your Majesty, I just about ate my boot when you made that decree."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""My fellow businessmen and I lost e..."
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow businessmen and I lost enough money granting all kinds of benefits to folks who don't even understand how lucky they are to work here. Giving them more would damn near bankrupt us."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""A little extreme, don't you think?""
entries.dialogueText: "A little extreme, don't you think?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I agree we shouldn't impose more r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree we shouldn't impose more regulations than necessary, but investing in safer and healthier employees could lead to profit in the long term. Foreigners included."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It has indeed been a mutually bene..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has indeed been a mutually beneficial partnership. I intend to keep it that way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Was it 'cooperation' when you wres..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was it 'cooperation' when you wrested away a third of the kingdom's stake?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't overinflate your company's i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't overinflate your company's importance. We have other resources."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Glad we're on the same page.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glad we're on the same page."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But only one is in the name of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But only one is in the name of the national anthem."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's the occasion?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's the occasion?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose you haven't invited us o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose you haven't invited us over here to marvel at your renovations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So how's business?""
entries.dialogueText: "So how's business?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Neat, aren't they? But no.""
entries.dialogueText: "Neat, aren't they? But no."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I couldn't help noticing you've be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't help noticing you've been crisscrossing the kingdom lately. And no royal tour would be complete without a visit to my modest little hideaway."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""A shame Her Highness couldn't make..."
entries.dialogueText: "A shame Her Highness couldn't make it. Too occupied with her latest beau?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""One dance does not a 'beau' make...."
entries.dialogueText: "One dance does not a 'beau' make. We'd appreciate it if you didn't speculate about Princess Vina's romantic prospects."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We'll get to that, Your Majesty. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get to that, Your Majesty. Settle down, have a drink first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please tell me what this meeting i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please tell me what this meeting is about. We don't have all day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's quite all right, Hugo. My d..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's quite all right, Hugo. My daughter does happen to have her eye on a special someone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Agreed. My daughter is a private p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. My daughter is a private person and her love life is strictly off-limits."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Lucky man. Anyway, I'll cut to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucky man. Anyway, I'll cut to the chase."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Well, all right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, all right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sat back and unbuttoned the top..."
entries.dialogueText: He sat back and unbuttoned the top button of his shirt.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But for now, our product is of hig..."
entries.dialogueText: "But for now, our product is of high enough quality that Rumburg is willing to pay more for it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes, but if the price rises furthe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but if the price rises further still? I'd rather not admit it, but Mr. Montoro may have a point."

entries.dialogueText: "Please excuse my uncle's hastiness. Lunch would be lovely."

entries.dialogueText: "Remind me. How did a man like him take over the most powerful corporation in Rizia?"

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Legend has it he worked his way up..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Sorry, Your Grace. Got to pretend..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Your Grace. Got to pretend to be civil to me a while longer."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That we are. Enjoy the trip back.""
entries.dialogueText: "That we are. Enjoy the trip back."

entries.dialogueText: The guard reluctantly bowed and stepped aside. Rusty ushered us past him, shaking his head as he did so.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You say I'm welcome. Your guards s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You say I'm welcome. Your guards send a different message."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I know what it seems like, but the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what it seems like, but they're looking out for your safety as well as mine. Can't be too careful after what happened in Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I passed the largest guard, I no..."
entries.dialogueText: As I passed the largest guard, I noticed he was wearing a badge that read 'Palantor Security Solutions.'"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes. 'Beers'. I would... enjoy tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. 'Beers'. I would... enjoy that."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""There you go! With your father, it..."
entries.dialogueText: "There you go! With your father, it was always 'Russello' this and 'Mr. Montoro' that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me say this straight away. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me say this straight away. Your wealth may excuse your lack of manners in some circles, but not with me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked stricken."
entries.dialogueText: He looked stricken.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I do beg your pardon. I never did..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do beg your pardon. I never did have time for fancy etiquette classes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena struggled to keep a pleasant..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena struggled to keep a pleasant expression on her face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was the Crown's to begin with...."
entries.dialogueText: "It was the Crown's to begin with. Queen Lyza never should have privatized it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your grandmother was a savvy dame...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your grandmother was a savvy dame. She saw an innovator and reached out her hand, 'stead of her fist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's troubling. Workers in this..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's troubling. Workers in this country should have a right to safety."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""They already do, Your Majesty. Som..."
entries.dialogueText: "They already do, Your Majesty. Someone's been stirring up trouble."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""First week on the job in Argno. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "First week on the job in Argno. Thought I'd save time by fixing a blockage in one of the ore processors. Reached right in, and wouldn't you know? It started working again."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""But did I blame RRG for my own bon..."
entries.dialogueText: "But did I blame RRG for my own boneheaded stupidity? Your Majesty, I did not."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Duke Hugo, why don't you show her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Hugo, why don't you show her the way? Maybe have a gander at my latest art acquisitions while you're at it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there something you've been kee..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the people want regulations, I'..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're beginning to test my patien..."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro

entries.dialogueText: "Wait, Your Majesty. You're going to want to hear this next part."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I heard you're thinking of bringin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard you're thinking of bringing some pretty big changes to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How do you know about that?""
entries.dialogueText: "How do you know about that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I'm planning changes. Changes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm planning changes. Changes that will keep people like you from hoarding wealth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not going to dignify that with..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro

entries.dialogueText: "But there's something else the people want more. Isn't there, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""So I was right.""
entries.dialogueText: "So I was right."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""People like me have bankrolled eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "People like me have bankrolled every major power shift since 1823. Arcasia, Qinal, Lespia... you name it, there's a fat wallet behind it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not opposed to working togeth..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not opposed to working together. But I want it to be on my terms."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""This is just the beginning, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is just the beginning, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""And if you really do want to pull..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if you really do want to pull the rug out from under the Rizian nobility, you're going to need the fattest wallet of all."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You don't have to respond. Just he..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to respond. Just hear me out for a second."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""All I know is, the word 'reform' h..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I know is, the word 'reform' has come up in connection with your name once or twice. And I don't mean the branch of Dastnurity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I did have such plans in store,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I did have such plans in store, what business would it be of yours?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Aha! So I'm right?""
entries.dialogueText: "Aha! So I'm right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go to hell, Mr. Montoro.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go to hell, Mr. Montoro."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: He shrugged.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""As you command, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you command, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The rumors are exaggerated. Any re..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rumors are exaggerated. Any reforms I put in place will be minor at the very most."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Minor or not, you know as well as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Minor or not, you know as well as I do that the nobility in this country doesn't take kindly to change."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He triumphantly gestured at himself..."
entries.dialogueText: He triumphantly gestured at himself. On seeing Hugo striding back towards us, he adopted a more serious posture.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You're going to need someone in yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're going to need someone in your corner. Someone with resources to burn and no scruples about burning them."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Just letting you know that I'm on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just letting you know that I'm on your side. Or I could be, if you let me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I am so, so, sorry. You can take t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am so, so, sorry. You can take the guards out of Arcasia, but you can't... well, you know."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Do you need an occasion to catch u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you need an occasion to catch up with an old friend?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Since when are you worried about t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since when are you worried about the Rizian People's Party, Mr. Montoro?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's right to be worried. With Man..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's right to be worried. With Manus Sazon in charge, the party could become a real threat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His Grace is right. The RPP doesn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Grace is right. The RPP doesn't have the power to change anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The party wants to bring the worke..."
entries.dialogueText: "The party wants to bring the workers' demands to the highest level of government. Admirable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The miners don't need the RPP to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "The miners don't need the RPP to help them. I'm the King. I can better their situation in an instant."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You can. But should you?""
entries.dialogueText: "You can. But should you?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Only in theory.""
entries.dialogueText: "Only in theory."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Except the public's mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "Except the public's mind."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Not if we steer them in the right..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not if we steer them in the right direction."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Better to focus on breaking new gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Better to focus on breaking new ground, if you ask me. Rumor has it your relatives in Valenqiris might be sitting on some *extremely* valuable real estate."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That said, the more unnecessary re..."
entries.dialogueText: "That said, the more unnecessary requirements we have to meet to extract that gold, the less of it you get to keep."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Will they make anyone safer? Doubt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Will they make anyone safer? Doubtful. Will they be a death blow to our bottom line? One hundred percent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still don't understand what you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't understand what you're getting at."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If the rumors are true, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the rumors are true, Your Majesty... I see huge potential for both of us to win big."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Hell, do you know how much growth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hell, do you know how much growth we're missing out on because international investors don't want to mess with an absolute monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I'm on your side. Or I could be, i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm on your side. Or I could be, if you let me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I take it as a positive sign that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take it as a positive sign that Mr. Montoro is open to renegotiating that stake. And I agree that over-regulation of our industries would hamper businesses while emboldening workers to a dangerous degree."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a crooked smile."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a crooked smile.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I know, Your Majesty. Every single..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Your Majesty. Every single day, I'm grateful for the privilege I've been given."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I would like nothing more than to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like nothing more than to pay it forward. Let RRG keep running the way we always have, and I swear I'll return the favor in triplicate."

entries.dialogueText: "We're in this together. What's good for Rizian Royal Gold is good for Rizian royals. And vice versa."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Just let us keep running things th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just let us keep running things the way we always have, and we'll take care of the rest."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I wouldn't have taken you for an a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't have taken you for an art connoisseur. Mr. Montoro. That Kolores fresco in your hallway is stunning."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cut himself off upon seeing Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: He cut himself off upon seeing Hugo striding back towards us.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Yeah, well. My pal Gus Manger conv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, well. My pal Gus Manger convinced me it was a good investment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cracked a smile."
entries.dialogueText: He cracked a smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo shuddered quietly."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo shuddered quietly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard enough. If I'd known yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard enough. If I'd known you'd invited me here only to wheedle favors out of me, I would have saved myself the trip."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Give me a hint, Your Majesty. Is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give me a hint, Your Majesty. Is the Crown on our side?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spread his arms wide."
entries.dialogueText: He spread his arms wide.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're indeed in this together. Kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're indeed in this together. Keep supplying the kingdom with gold, and I will take care of any obstacles in RRG's way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The only side I'm on is that of or..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only side I'm on is that of ordinary, hard-working Rizians. I want what is best for them, even if our gold reserves suffer."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""If I'm wrong, go ahead and tell me..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I'm wrong, go ahead and tell me to go to hell. All you nobles do, anyway."
